sections.name: shared part inspection
sections.title: Six inspector checks
sections.what: Runs six checks: legacy components show nothing; a part shows its size and escapes markup; a bound source shows file, page and derivation; a missing source is reported; and long lists stop at 40 parts or 20 source records, with show-more buttons.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the rules the inspector must keep, so they are written down as automatic checks.
sections.watch_out: The checks read rendered text only, so the show-more buttons are not clicked and their behaviour is not tested.

summary: Automatic checks that the part inspector shows the right text, escapes unsafe text, and limits long lists.
purpose: Protects the rules that part sizes, source links and limits are shown clearly and safely.
why: Likely reason: the inspector must never hide missing evidence or show raw markup, so these checks run each time.
how: Builds a sample part and a sample source record, renders the inspector as plain text, and checks that expected phrases are present or absent. The list-limit checks create 45 items and count the rows shown.
inputs: A sample part, a sample source record and small sample component lists written inside the file.
outputs: Pass or fail results for six named checks. Nothing is saved.
risks: The checks read text only, not layout or clicks, and the sample data can drift from the real data types.
debug: If a check fails, compare the expected phrase with the text produced by PartInspector.tsx, and confirm the sample matches the types in types.ts.
